// probe checks DECISIONS 401 and CODEGEN.md §5.9 (Addresses) on generated TypeScript and prints one
// `<check> ok` or `<check> FAIL` line each (TestStableAddressesTS): for one row, find(k) === at(i)
// === all[i], in a baked table (bk), a baked keyed list and a decoded data file (da). It is run
// with the data file the build wrote as its argument.
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import * as bk from "./bk.js";
import * as da from "./da.js";

function check(name, ok) {
  console.log(name + (ok ? " ok" : " FAIL"));
}

check("baked-find-is-at-is-all", bk.statuses.find("open") === bk.statuses.at(0) && bk.statuses.at(0) === bk.statuses.all[0]);
check("baked-find-repeats", bk.statuses.find("taken") === bk.statuses.find("taken") && bk.statuses.find("taken") === bk.statuses.at(1));
check("baked-all-repeats", bk.statuses.all === bk.statuses.all && bk.statuses.all[2] === bk.statuses.at(2));
check("baked-keyed-find-is-at-is-all", bk.tasks.find("first") === bk.tasks.at(0) && bk.tasks.at(0) === bk.tasks.all[0]);

const items = da.parseItems(readFileSync(process.argv[2], "utf8"));
check("data-find-is-at-is-all", items.find("a") === items.at(0) && items.at(0) === items.all[0]);
check("data-find-repeats", items.find("b") === items.find("b") && items.find("b") === items.all[1]);
check("data-all-repeats", items.all === items.all);
